```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(keras)
library(tensorflow)
library(reticulate)

use_virtualenv("r-tf", required = TRUE)
```

load baseline response data 
```{r}
load("../../data/respondersig-output-baseline.rds")
```

```{r}
# Find indices where Group == "Experimental"
keep_idx <- which(rsig.baseline$Group == "Experimental")

# Filter all list elements by these indices
rsig.filt <- lapply(rsig.baseline, function(x) {
  if (is.data.frame(x)) {
    x[keep_idx, , drop = FALSE]  
  } else {
    x[keep_idx]                  
  }
})

taxa <- rsig.filt$Uncorrected
response <- rsig.filt$Response 
response <- ifelse(response == "R", 1, 0)
```

split testing and training 
```{r}
set.seed(43202)

train_idx <- sample(seq_len(nrow(taxa)), size = 0.8 * nrow(taxa))

X_train <- taxa[train_idx, ]
X_test  <- taxa[-train_idx, ]
y_train <- response[train_idx]
y_test  <- response[-train_idx]

# 7. Convert to matrices/numeric vectors
X_train <- as.matrix(X_train)
X_test  <- as.matrix(X_test)
y_train <- as.numeric(y_train)
y_test  <- as.numeric(y_test)
```

```{r}
# 1) Scale using TRAIN stats only (no leakage)
X_train_sc <- scale(X_train)
ctr <- attr(X_train_sc, "scaled:center")
scl <- attr(X_train_sc, "scaled:scale")
X_test_sc  <- scale(X_test, center = ctr, scale = scl)

input_dim <- ncol(X_train_sc)

model <- keras_model_sequential(
  list(
    layer_dense(units = 32, activation = "relu", input_shape = input_dim),
    layer_dropout(rate = 0.3),
    layer_dense(units = 16, activation = "relu"),
    layer_dropout(rate = 0.3),
    layer_dense(units = 1, activation = "sigmoid")
  )
)

# Compile
model %>% compile(
  optimizer = "adam",
  loss = "binary_crossentropy",
  metrics = c("accuracy")
)


#############################

model |>
  compile(
    optimizer = optimizer_adam(learning_rate = 1e-3),
    loss = "binary_crossentropy",
    metrics = c("accuracy", metric_auc(name="auc"))
  )

cb <- list(
  callback_early_stopping(monitor = "val_auc", mode = "max", patience = 15, restore_best_weights = TRUE)
)

# 3) Train
history <- model |>
  fit(
    x = as.matrix(X_train_sc),
    y = as.numeric(y_train),
    epochs = 200,
    batch_size = 16,
    validation_split = 0.2,
    callbacks = cb,
    verbose = 1
  )

# 4) Evaluate on TEST
ev <- model |>
  evaluate(as.matrix(X_test_sc), as.numeric(y_test), verbose = 0)

cat(sprintf("Test Accuracy: %.3f\n", ev[["accuracy"]]))
cat(sprintf("Test AUC:      %.3f\n", ev[["auc"]]))

# 5) Predictions, ROC, confusion matrix
p_test <- as.numeric(model |> predict(as.matrix(X_test_sc)))
roc_obj <- roc(y_test, p_test)
cat(sprintf("pROC AUC:      %.3f\n", as.numeric(auc(roc_obj))))

pred_class <- as.integer(p_test >= 0.5)
table(Predicted=pred_class, Actual=y_test)
```
